text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
What's this? King, you haven't even
touched your
yogurt!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, because I'm aiming to be in
first-rate shape
for my next race.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yippee! Then, give it to me! I'm still
hungry, no
matter how much food I
munch on!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
You're welcome to it, but... are you sure
that's a
good idea? You might consider
tightening up
your diet as well.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'd like my competition to be in tip-top
shape,
you know. Otherwi—

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
You don't need to worry about me! I run
a tight
ship. As tight as the knot on a
lucky talisman.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then perhaps you could
explain why
your skirt looks so tight!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Gyaah! How cruel can you beee?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What in the world?! I think the clasp of
your skirt
just flew off and hit me on the
forehead!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe, maybe it was divine
punishment...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's it! You get outside and get running! That's your punishment for letting that thing hit me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanefukukitaru's morning run helps
her get
back in shape.
